infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: When you choose THIS PHONE to answer, it hears what you say to your daemon on the phone itself.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DAEMONS never looks through your photos. It asks only if you choose to save a page or a picture there.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: To reach your DAEMONS companion on your computer, at home.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: While your daemon sleeps, picking up your phone stirs it. The app reads only how often the phone moved in the night.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: THE CALENDAR shows your calendar's events by month, week and day, and adds, changes or removes the ones you ask it to. They stay on this phone.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: THE CALENDAR shows your calendar's events by month, week and day, and adds, changes or removes the ones you ask it to. They stay on this phone.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: DAEMONS never reads or changes your reminders. Only THE CALENDAR's events are shown.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: DAEMONS never reads or changes your reminders. Only THE CALENDAR's events are shown.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Your steps today count toward your walking goal, and your daemon is glad of the walk.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: DAEMONS never writes to Health; it only reads your steps for your walking goal.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: To carry your handheld's link: its goal, its daemon and its routines, at home or away.

plugins.microphonePermission: Hold TALK to speak with your daemon, or record a meeting for it to write up. What is recorded is turned into words on your own companion server.

plugins.calendarPermission: THE CALENDAR shows your calendar's events by month, week and day, and adds, changes or removes the ones you ask it to. They stay on this phone.
